scope: Discord archived guest viewport, full uBlock Origin, original-origin offline replay, cold cache,1024x768 logical pixels. Pending-image effect scope repair with focused planner regression and unchanged full rendering suite.
cause: Zero-size undecoded images are deliberately retained to initiate requests even outside the geometric cull. The effect-visibility pass omitted their ancestors, so an offscreen CSS effect opener was culled while its pending image and closer survived. A later main-document image observed native transparency depth -1 and lost its readable opaque-backdrop flag. This changes223 alpha-edge pixels in the visible portion of Party Wumpus.
fix: Mark effect ancestry visible for pending zero-size images as well as geometrically interested chunks. Keep matching effect scopes balanced; ordinary nonzero offscreen image effects still cull. No native counter clamp, image decoder or sampling changes.
